summary: Keep managed session start dates stable when an incarnation begins after the first 10,000 agent claims

replay.detail: Dates are read from existing accepted claims; no replay is needed.

schema.detail: No database, index, or client-v0 schema changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet rules changes.

compatibility.detail: Incarnation dates include all matching claims at the snapshot, using the existing two index seeks. The legacy runtime-only scan keeps its 10,000-claim bound. Client v0 requires started_at, so missing span evidence falls back to the actual observation acceptance time (then the first subject claim, then the Unix epoch), never the snapshot time.

downtime.detail: No interruption beyond ordinary binary deployment.

manual.detail: No manual data changes are required.

recovery.detail: Ordinary binary rollback preserves all claims.
